# Context standard

Default records are `README.md`, `INDEX.md`, `PROJECT_STATE.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `HANDOFF.md`, and `SOURCE_MANIFEST.md` under `docs/project-context/`. Add architecture, risks, framework integration, summaries, and reconciliation reports only when complexity justifies them. Create missing records only; map to an established structure rather than competing with it.

Each claim has one status: **Verified** (reproducible evidence), **Approved** (identified authorization), **Implemented** (present but not independently validated), **Proposed** (draft), **Inferred** (interpretation), **Unresolved** (missing/conflicting evidence), or **Superseded** (replaced source). Dates, sources, owners, and uncertainty are first-class fields.
